title: Joe Schoen: Giants weren’t moving from No. 5 if Arvell Reese was available

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joe Schoen: Giants weren’t moving from No. 5 if Arvell Reese was available
sources.description: New York Giants general manager Joe Schoen said during an appearance on Sirius XM NFL Radio that the Giants were not going to move down from No. 5 in the 2026 NFL Draft when it became clear Arvell Reese would be available to them. “We had a couple players in mind that if they were […]
